extraction.method: Preserve complete raw XML subtrees for the authorial preface and seven printed Warres books; retain original TCP header; concatenate selected subtrees without inter-subtree formatting whitespace.
extraction.markup: All source headings, tables of contents, page breaks, marginal notes, character markup and illegibility gaps retained. Analysis stream excludes headings/notes and joins empty EOLhyphen character elements only for finding boundaries; extraction is unchanged.
extraction.excluded: Bellum title page and Lodge dedication to Anthony Palmer; Antiquities, Life, Contra Apionem, Rule of Reason, index.

candidate_encoding.hierarchy: div1 book -> div2 frozen Cardwell chapter -> p stable coarse unit -> milestone Niese citation
candidate_encoding.source_structure_normalization: TCP block elements (div, p, head, byline, list, item, argument, closer, opener, signed, trailer, lg, l, table, row, cell) become inline seg type=tcp-element with original XPath corresp. Original type is retained as tcp:type. Other TCP elements/attributes are retained. Source elements crossing a project boundary are closed and reopened, so typography/notes remain well-formed. Original xml:id attributes, if any, are recorded as tcp:xml-id and given distinct Lodge IDs. No added whitespace in candidate body.
candidate_encoding.text_invariance: All source text nodes, including headings, contents, marginal notes, gap descriptions and formatting whitespace, occur once, in original order. XML entity spelling and empty-element serialization may differ; decoded XML text is identical after XML line-ending normalization.
candidate_encoding.omission_encoding: VI.3 is the sole whole-section omission, represented by an empty gap. Twelve OMITTED_AT_BOUNDARY cases concern absent, compressed or displaced opening wording, including resolved I.24. No unresolved zero-length span remains.
candidate_encoding.links: No sameAs alignment claims are emitted; unit correspondence is recorded in the registers.
candidate_encoding.analysis_offsets: UTF-16 offsets into a diagnostic stream of narrative p text excluding note; synthetic newline after each p. These offsets locate evidence and do not define textual authority.
candidate_encoding.tsv_escapes: Literal backslash, tab, CR and LF are represented by \, \t, \r and \n; unescape to recover exact source excerpts.

candidate_encoding.status_vocabulary: SUBSTANTIVE_DIFFERENCE and PARAPHRASE export as SUBSTANTIVE_ALIGNMENT. The two final human decisions supersede their earlier MEDIUM assessments, preserved in history. All other saved decisions are unchanged.
candidate_encoding.confidence_scope: All 4001 placements are HIGH. Retained HIGH review flags concern accepted source divergences, damage, omissions or non-contiguous correspondence, not unchecked boundary placement. Neither resolved human case remains in REVIEW.
